title: Urban Greenspace Thermal Ranking — Santiago
text:
This document maps all urban greenspaces in the Santiago Metropolitan Region (MINVU registry) and ranks them by surface temperature extracted from the SantiagoHOT dataset — a high-resolution (10 m) thermal model covering three moments of a summer day in 2024: morning (AM · 07–08 h), afternoon (AF · 16–17 h), and evening (PM · 19–20 h).
Parks are colour-coded by their dominant vegetation structure (woody vs herbaceous/grass) and temperature decile within each group. Priority sampling sites selected for field soil analysis are highlighted as circle markers. Renders on committed files only — no GEE credentials needed.

Source code: Urban-Soil-Biophysics/stgohot-greenspaces

Parks are colour-coded by their dominant vegetation structure (woody vs herbaceous/grass) and temperature decile within each group. Priority sampling sites selected for field soil analysis are highlighted as circle markers. Renders on committed files only — no GEE credentials needed.

title: Urban Greenspace Thermal Ranking — Santiago
text:
1 · Load and classify park polygons


Show code
parks_raw <- st_read(
  "data/geo-data/parques_urbanos_minvu.geojson",
  quiet = TRUE
)

# Base R only — dplyr verbs cause list-coercion on this sf object
parks_r13 <- parks_raw[
  !is.na(parks_raw$REGION) & parks_raw$REGION == 13,
]

parks_r13$greenspace_type <- dplyr::case_when(
  stringr::str_detect(parks_r13$NOMBRE,
    regex("parque", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Urban Park",
  stringr::str_detect(parks_r13$NOMBRE,
    regex("plaza|plazoleta|jardin|jardines|santuario|estadio|deporte|deportivo|campo|piscina",
          ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Lawn Park",
  stringr::str_detect(parks_r13$NOMBRE,
    regex("bandejon|bandejón|rotonda|canal|estero|autopista",
          ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Roadside",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

parks_r13 <- parks_r13[!is.na(parks_r13$greenspace_type), ]
parks_r13$park_id <- seq_len(nrow(parks_r13))
parks_r13$area_m2 <- as.numeric(parks_r13$SUPERFICIE)
parks_r13$area_ha <- round(parks_r13$area_m2 / 1e4, 2)
parks_r13$name    <- as.character(parks_r13$NOMBRE)
parks_r13$commune <- as.character(parks_r13$COM)

# Keep only atomic columns — drops all list columns from source geojson
keep_cols <- c("park_id", "name", "commune",
               "area_m2", "area_ha", "greenspace_type")
parks_clean <- parks_r13[, keep_cols]

# Rebuild geometry cleanly through WKB
geom_wkb   <- sf::st_as_binary(sf::st_geometry(parks_clean))
geom_clean <- sf::st_as_sfc(geom_wkb, crs = 4326)
parks <- sf::st_set_geometry(
  sf::st_drop_geometry(parks_clean),
  geom_clean
) |> sf::st_as_sf()

sprintf("Parks loaded: %d | Types: %s",
        nrow(parks),
        paste(unique(parks$greenspace_type), collapse = ", "))


[1] "Parks loaded: 531 | Types: Lawn Park, Urban Park, Roadside"

title: Urban Greenspace Thermal Ranking — Santiago
text:
2 · Extract StgoHOT surface temperatures


Show code
stgo_am <- rast("data/stgo-hot/santiago-chile_am_temp_c.tif")
stgo_af <- rast("data/stgo-hot/santiago-chile_af_temp_c.tif")
stgo_pm <- rast("data/stgo-hot/santiago-chile_pm_temp_c.tif")

parks_utm <- sf::st_transform(parks, 32719)

temp_am <- exact_extract(stgo_am, parks_utm, "mean", progress = FALSE)
temp_af <- exact_extract(stgo_af, parks_utm, "mean", progress = FALSE)
temp_pm <- exact_extract(stgo_pm, parks_utm, "mean", progress = FALSE)

# Build as plain dataframe — avoid sf method dispatch issues
parks_thermal_df <- sf::st_drop_geometry(parks_utm)
parks_thermal_df$temp_am_c    <- temp_am
parks_thermal_df$temp_af_c    <- temp_af
parks_thermal_df$temp_pm_c    <- temp_pm
parks_thermal_df$temp_range_c <- temp_af - temp_am

has_temp   <- !is.na(parks_thermal_df$temp_af_c)
thermal_df <- parks_thermal_df[has_temp, ]
geom_therm <- geom_clean[has_temp]

parks_thermal <- sf::st_set_geometry(thermal_df, geom_therm) |>
  sf::st_as_sf() |>
  sf::st_transform(4326)

sprintf("Parks with temperature data: %d", nrow(parks_thermal))

text:
7 · Temperature distribution by vegetation group


Show code
ranked_df |>
  dplyr::filter(veg_group %in% c("Woody", "Grass", "Mixed")) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    c(temp_am_c, temp_af_c, temp_pm_c),
    names_to = "moment", values_to = "temp_c"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    moment = factor(moment,
      levels = c("temp_am_c", "temp_af_c", "temp_pm_c"),
      labels = c("Morning\n(07–08 h)",
                 "Afternoon\n(16–17 h)",
                 "Evening\n(19–20 h)"))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = veg_group, y = temp_c, fill = veg_group)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~moment) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Woody = "#41ab5d", Grass = "#fc9272", Mixed = "#9e9ac8")
  ) +
  labs(title    = "Surface temperature by vegetation structure",
       subtitle = "StgoHOT — all MINVU parks, Santiago RM, summer 2024",
       x = NULL, y = "Mean surface temperature (°C)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

text:
9 · NDVI — vegetation vigor


Show code
ndvi_path <- "data/geo-data/NDVI_Santiago_Jan2024_30m.tif"

if (file.exists(ndvi_path)) {

  ndvi_rast     <- terra::rast(ndvi_path)
  parks_for_ndvi <- sf::st_transform(parks_thermal, 32719)
  ndvi_vals      <- exact_extract(ndvi_rast, parks_for_ndvi, "mean",
                                   progress = FALSE)

  ndvi_df <- ranked_df |>
    dplyr::mutate(ndvi_mean_calc = ndvi_vals) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(ndvi_mean_calc), veg_group != "Unclassified")

  p_ndvi_type <- ndvi_df |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(greenspace_type)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = greenspace_type, y = ndvi_mean_calc,
               fill = greenspace_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.8) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.25, size = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Urban Park" = "#2d6a4f",
      "Lawn Park"  = "#95d5b2",
      "Roadside"   = "#e76f51"
    )) +
    labs(title = "NDVI by park type",
         x = NULL, y = "Mean NDVI") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  p_ndvi_veg <- ndvi_df |>
    ggplot(aes(x = veg_group, y = ndvi_mean_calc, fill = veg_group)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.8) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.25, size = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(Woody = "#41ab5d", Grass = "#fc9272", Mixed = "#9e9ac8")
    ) +
    labs(title = "NDVI by vegetation group",
         subtitle = "Landsat 8 — January 2024 (30m)",
         x = NULL, y = "Mean NDVI") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  p_ndvi_temp <- ndvi_df |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(temp_af_c)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = ndvi_mean_calc, y = temp_af_c, color = veg_group)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
                color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(Woody = "#41ab5d", Grass = "#fc9272", Mixed = "#9e9ac8")
    ) +
    labs(title = "NDVI vs afternoon temperature",
         x = "Mean NDVI", y = "AF temperature (°C)",
         color = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  p_ndvi_type + p_ndvi_veg + p_ndvi_temp +
    plot_layout(ncol = 3) +
    plot_annotation(
      title    = "NDVI — vegetation vigor across Santiago greenspaces",
      subtitle = "Landsat 8 & 9 Collection 2 Level 2 | January 2024 | 30m resolution"
    )

} else {
  cat("NDVI raster not found — expected at:", ndvi_path)
}

om_joined_path  <- "data/results/om_ranking_joined.csv"
om_summary_path <- "data/results/om_ranking_summary.csv"

if (file.exists(om_joined_path)) {

  om_data <- readr::read_csv(om_joined_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  p_type <- om_data |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(greenspace_type)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = greenspace_type, y = om_value,
               fill = greenspace_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 1) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Urban Park" = "#2d6a4f",
      "Lawn Park"  = "#95d5b2",
      "Roadside"   = "#e76f51"
    )) +
    labs(title = "Soil OM by park type",
         x = NULL, y = "Organic matter (%)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  p_woody <- om_data |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(woody_ratio)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = woody_ratio, y = om_value,
               color = greenspace_type)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
                color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Urban Park" = "#2d6a4f",
      "Lawn Park"  = "#95d5b2",
      "Roadside"   = "#e76f51"
    )) +
    labs(title = "Soil OM ~ woody ratio",
         x = "Woody ratio (0–1)", y = "Organic matter (%)",
         color = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  p_temp <- om_data |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(stgohot_decile_mean)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = stgohot_decile_mean, y = om_value,
               color = greenspace_type)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
                color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Urban Park" = "#2d6a4f",
      "Lawn Park"  = "#95d5b2",
      "Roadside"   = "#e76f51"
    )) +
    labs(title = "Soil OM ~ temperature decile",
         x = "StgoHOT mean decile (1=cool, 10=hot)",
         y = "Organic matter (%)", color = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  p_cond <- om_data |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(condition)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = om_value, fill = condition)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 1) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Good condition" = "#52b788",
      "Poor condition" = "#e76f51"
    )) +
    labs(title = "Soil OM by park condition",
         x = NULL, y = "Organic matter (%)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  (p_type + p_cond) / (p_woody + p_temp) +
    plot_annotation(
      title    = "Soil organic matter associations with park characteristics",
      subtitle = sprintf(
        "Field data: n = %d points | Spatially joined to nearest MINVU park",
        nrow(om_data)
      )
    )

} else {
  cat("OM association file not found — run scripts/ranking/05_soil_om_association.R first.")
}
